verdict.rationale: Pilot's evidence describes a human-led bookkeeping service in which dedicated accounting experts finalize the books each month. The only AI feature documented is Q&A about past transactions and cash flow, which is a different capability. Nothing shows an agent that matches transactions, flags exceptions, and prepares the month-end close for human review.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
